newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf shares jump on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Wharf shares jump on bargain hunting.

text.p: Shares of conglomerate Wharf (Holdings) Ltd soared on Thursday morning on bargain hunting as investors bought blue chips after the Hang Seng Index found support above its 12,000 level, brokers said.
Wharf rose HK$1.05, or 3.7 percent, to HK$29.60 near midday on turnover of 1.41 million shares worth HK$40.93 million.
"Wharf fell quite a lot recently and should warrant a rebound," a broker said.
The stock plunged nearly 14 percent in March. Analysts had lowered their 1997 profit forecasts for the company after it announced a 24 percent decline in 1996 earnings last month.
The Hang Seng index rebounded strongly late Thursday morning after initially dropping sharply to a low of 12,013.51.
